english.title: Assault or obstruct a British sea-fishery officer exercising powers when on vessel within British fishery limits
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), on a vessel within British fishery limits, namely **(..SPECIFY VESSEL..),

(A)_[assaulted **(..SPECIFY OFFICER..), a British sea-fishery officer while exercising]_
(B)_[wilfully obstructed **(..SPECIFY OFFICER..), a British sea-fishery officer in the exercise of]_

a power conferred on

(C)_[him]_
(D)_[her]_

by section 27 of the Fisheries Act 1981
english.legislation: Contrary to section 10(2A)(c) and (4) of the Sea Fisheries Act 1968.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
person on a vessel
within British fishery limits
assaulted/wilfully obstructed
a British sea-fishery officer
while exercising any of the powers conferred on him /her by section 27 of the Sea Fisheries Act 1981

investigatoraction.description: Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) MoPI notes: may be Group 3 if there is no assault/violence.
(ii) Section 14 of the Sea Fisheries Act 1968 provides that proceedings for an offence under section 10 may be taken, and the offence may for all incidental purposes be treated as having been committed, in any place in the United Kingdom.
